description_en: Queries access control lists (ACLs) created for a private gateway
description_zh: 查看网关访问权限的列表
kebab_example: aliyun eas list-acl-policy --cluster-id cn-wulanchabu --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAclPolicy

parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The private gateway ID. To obtain the private gateway ID, see the private_gateway_id parameter in the response parameters of the ListResources operation
parameters.help_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见ListResources接口返回结果中的private_gateway_id字段
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). For more information about how to obtain the VPC ID, see DescribeVpcs
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络的ID。如何获取专有网络ID，请参见DescribeVpcs
parameters.name: vpc_id

InternetAclPolicyList.description_en: The access control policies of the private gateway over the Internet

items.description_en: The access control policy of the private gateway over the Internet

AclPolicyList.description_en: The whitelisted IP CIDR blocks in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the Internet
AclPolicyList.description_zh: 专有网络可访问公网IP段白名单列表

items.description_en: The information about the IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the Internet
items.description_zh: 专有网络公网可访问IP段信息

Comment.description_en: The comment on the IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the Internet
Comment.description_zh: 专有网络公网可访问IP段备注信息

Entry.description_en: The IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the Internet
Entry.description_zh: 专有网络公网可访问IP段

items.description_en: The access control policy of the private gateway over the internal network

AclPolicyList.description_en: The whitelisted IP CIDR blocks in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the internal network
AclPolicyList.description_zh: 专有网络可访问内网IP段白名单列表

items.description_en: The information about the IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the internal network
items.description_zh: 专有网络内网可访问IP段信息

Comment.description_en: The comment on the IP CIDR block in the VPC that can access the private gateway over the internal network
Comment.description_zh: 专有网络内网可访问IP段备注信息

Entry.description_zh: 专有网络内网可访问IP段

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID. For more information about how to obtain the VPC ID, see DescribeVpcs
VpcId.description_zh: 专有网络的ID。如何获取专有网络ID，请参见DescribeVpcs
